verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own docs describe an app-level lock: a custom lock screen that supports PINs and passwords, and a FaceID lock enabled under Settings → Security → Lockscreen. Both biometrics and PIN are covered, but only by brief first-party mentions. Missing for 10: documentation of auto-lock timing (e.g. locking when the app is backgrounded), confirmation of biometric unlock beyond FaceID on other platforms, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes

citations.quote: You can now further protect your codes with a custom lock screen that supports PINs and passwords.
You can enable FaceID lock under Settings → Security → Lockscreen.
